verdict.rationale: SendGrid provides a well-documented REST v3 Web API, SMTP interface, official SDKs, cURL examples, webhooks (event and inbound parse), and sandbox mode for testing — all clearly documented for programmatic/API-driven use, which is exactly what an AI-native agent would need. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/completeness (community evidence focuses on deliverability/abuse issues, not API usability) and no explicit mention of OpenAPI spec or agent-specific tooling.
